name: nami-contracts
description: The nami contract: TypeSpec models, the in-repo emitters and the generation scripts. `bun run compile` writes openapi/nami.openapi.json (intermediate), internal/nami.contracts and json-schema/.

scripts.build:emitters: tsc -p emitters/csharp && tsc -p emitters/ts-types && tsc -p emitters/nami-lint && tsc -p agent-control
scripts.compile: bun run build:emitters && node --test scripts/lib/*.test.mjs emitters/nami-lint/test/*.test.mjs && node scripts/clean-generated.mjs && tsp compile main.tsp --warn-as-error && node scripts/emit-schemas.mjs && node scripts/emit-contract-revision.mjs
scripts.lint: bun run build:emitters && tsp compile main.tsp --no-emit --warn-as-error && node scripts/check-suppressions.mjs
